stories.title: Daughter of WWII veteran selling ‘door poppies’ to support local Legion
stories.summary: Margot Rockett’s father served in the Air Force in the Second World War. In the last few years of his life, Rockett said he lived at the Sunnybrook Veterans Centre.

stories.title: Price, Bergeron headline 2026 Hall of Fame class
stories.summary: Carey Price spent a lot of his youth on the road and in the air.

stories.title: Unifor says it believes Stellantis sold its Brampton plant
stories.summary: In a statement released Friday, Unifor's bargaining team said it met with Stellantis to discuss reports that the plant had been sold.

stories.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions Canadian firms connected to Ryan Wedding and Iran
stories.summary: The department says it sanctioned money services businesses in British Columbia and Ontario in co-ordination with Fintrac, Canada's anti-money laundering watchdog.

stories.title: Roommate who tried to intervene in fatal attack on woman speaks out
stories.summary: A woman is speaking out after she witnessed a brutal attack on her roommate last Saturday.

stories.title: Alek Minassian, convicted in deadly 2018 Toronto van attack, drops appeal
stories.summary: Ontario's top court says Alek Minassian has abandoned the appeal of his convictions on 10 counts of first-degree murder and 16 of attempted murder.

stories.title: Bail granted for former junior hockey exec accused of sex crimes against players
stories.summary: Tyler King, 39, is facing charges of luring, sexual exploitation and making child pornography. He was granted bail by an Alberta court Friday.

stories.title: CN freight train collides with tractor trailer towing flatbed near Brighton, Ont.
stories.summary: A collision involving a CN freight train has shut down a section of road in Brighton, Ont. near the city of Quinte West.

stories.title: Joly seeks Competition Bureau probe of Stelco as more layoffs loom
stories.summary: The federal government is asking the competition commissioner to 'thoroughly examine' if Stelco owner Cleveland-Cliffs breached the Competition Act.

stories.title: Ontario businesses gain ‘fragile’ optimism on trade after U.S. midterms
stories.summary: Economic uncertainty due to Trump’s tariff regime has lead to upheaval for Ontario's businesses that has required increased resilience.
